scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.lint: if find packages -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.jsx' \) -print -quit | grep -q .; then oxlint --deny-warnings .; else echo 'No source files to lint'; fi
scripts.typecheck: if find packages -mindepth 2 -name tsconfig.json -print -quit | grep -q .; then tsc -b; else echo 'No TypeScript packages yet'; fi
